Follow the
[VS Code Profile onboarding skill](../skills/vscode-profile-onboarding/SKILL.md).

Detect the current VS Code remote environment, validate the repository profile artifacts, apply
the shared WSL machine settings when applicable, and provide only the remaining user-visible
Profile import or switch steps. Do not modify Azure identity, runtime, deployment, or personal
editor settings outside the shared contract.
